title: Replace snapshot-only reporting with validated evidence ingestion
objective: Acceptance reports consume real evidence. Validated receipts can change calculated results without manually editing an accepted flag.
outcome: Receipts are validated by identity and referenced bytes. Stale, duplicate, mismatched, and incomplete evidence is rejected. Observation days/cycles and attempt-ledger counts are calculated from validated evidence. Technical success is distinct from scientific approval. Previous failed reports are retained as history. accepted flags remain unedited. Frozen cohorts.json is unmodified. R01-R16 remain unaccepted. C-009-1 remains unresolved. No 8+8 participants, 14 elapsed days, two scheduled cycles, AT/browser evidence, AUTH-12, or production rollout are invented.

commits.subject: Validate evidence identities and referenced bytes
commits.instructions: Add a receipt ingest path that hashes referenced bytes, rejects stale/duplicate/mismatched/incomplete evidence, and never sets accepted.
commits.verification: Tests reject bad receipts and accept structurally valid fixtures without treating them as scientific approval.

commits.subject: Calculate observation and attempt outcomes from receipts
commits.instructions: Extend observe.mjs and the R01/R03 attempt ledger so validated receipts change calculated days, cycles, and accounted axis counts. Caller-supplied counters remain rejected.
commits.verification: A valid receipt fixture changes calculated results; empty/missing receipts retain the previous failed/unverified snapshot. accepted remains false.

commits.subject: Record remediation tasks and parallel collection packets
commits.instructions: Create one remediation task per failed/unverified requirement. Publish facilitator packet and C-009-1 account-information request without inventing participants or bills.
commits.verification: Each failed requirement has a task file. Facilitator packet requires 8+8 real participants. C-009-1 request lists required account facts and leaves topology unresolved.
